definitions.explanation: Weak, self-pitying complaints or expressions of helplessness. Carries a negative nuance of complaining without trying to solve the problem.

examples.japanese: {泣|な}き{言|ごと}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}っていて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Nothing will change if you just keep complaining.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{泣|な}き{言|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わ→言う：00515_iu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やり{遂|と}げた→やり遂げる：16745_yaritogeru⟧。
examples.english: He completed the job without complaining until the very end.

notes:
USAGE: {泣|な}き{言|ごと} implies weak, self-pitying complaints rather than legitimate grievances. It is most commonly used in the pattern {泣|な}き{言|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to whine, to complain).

The word carries a negative connotation — using it implies that the speaker considers the complaints unjustified or unproductive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泣|な}き{言|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to whine, to complain
- {泣|な}き{言|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わない→言う：00515_iu⟧: to not complain
- {泣|な}き{言|ごと}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧: nothing but whining

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {泣|な}き{言|ごと}: self-pitying complaint (negative nuance)
- ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧: grumbling, griping (general complaint)
- ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧: complaint, objection (can be legitimate or not)
